answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat block bulk fakes. Each agent posts a heartbeat proof per epoch, tied to a random beacon. The beacon summons a sample to dock at the wharf and re-prove liveness; a miss freezes the bond and flags referrers. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 POA per epoch, 40,000 POA, against a 5,000 POA pool. Honest agents pay 40 POA once and keep the full nectar; each fake sends a ripple exposing its siblings.
